text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, January 25, 2019 Posted by admin on January 25th, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +170 points.
Thursday the Dow was down -22.38 (-0.09%) AT 24,553.24.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +5.25%.
There were 13 Dow stocks up Thursday.
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by Intel (INTC) +3.80%, Chevron (CVX) +1.90% and Travelers (TRV) +1.11%.
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by Merck (MRK) -3.01%, Pfizer (PFE) -2.87% and Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) -1.37%.
A dim earnings report is sinking Intel (INTC) shares by 6% in premarket trading. Intel (INTC) missed on fourth-quarter revenue, coming in slightly below analysts’ expectations at $18.7 billion. Intel also slightly cut its first quarter 2019 guidance to $16.1 billion, about $1.5 billion below analysts’ expectations.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down one-tenth of a cent at $2.273 per gallon.
